dry_walkthrough: Research repo instructions first; reference remote and HEAD checked; invalid explicit path stops.
Offline requirements and reviewable plan; dirty/untracked inclusion explicit; code and large assets separated.
Unfilled commands withheld; reading does not authorize SSH, transfer, installation or paid smoke.
Existing bounded smoke authorization reused; missing or expanded scope needs approval.
Unknown submission preserved without retry; main job and steps plus artifacts required.
Download destination in research run directory; local and remote shells distinguished.
Lab pull requires clean main/origin/main; dirty or diverged stops without reset or stash.
